subject: ACK Core V1 needs-revision disposition; adaptive training gates tightened
body: ACK the Manager Core V1 NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE/revision disposition. Adaptive profile research has reconciled the generation fence, delivery/source time validation, and pipeline-lead ownership gaps: learned timing is disabled unless exact-current generation, monotonic source/delivery clocks, non-negative source age, and an unambiguous single-owner lead contract are all present. Design handoff will explicitly mark unchanged Core V1 as not ready for adaptive runtime integration.
